content.title: Peloton Slides After Hiking Prices in Sweeping Product Revamp
content.summary: The new products, announced Wednesday, include new versions of the Bike and Bike+, Tread and Tread+ and the replacement of the Row with a Row+, confirming an August Bloomberg report.  To go along with the new models, Peloton is implementing significant price increases, with an average bump of around 11% for hardware and 19% for the subscription fees.  “We know that every dollar is precious and people are considering how to spend their money these days," Chief Executive Officer Peter Stern said in an interview with Bloomberg Television.
